claim: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative disease with a high prevalence in the elderly population.
source: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative disease with a high prevalence in the elderly population, but our understanding of its mechanisms remains incomplete.
evidence: This is a general statement about OA that draws from established medical knowledge about the disease's characteristics and demographics.

claim: miR-199b-5p is a common dysregulated miRNA found in serum exosomal small RNA sequencing data from clinical patients and gene expression data from OA patient serum and cartilage.
source: Analysis of serum exosomal small RNA sequencing data from clinical patients and gene expression data from OA patient serum and cartilage obtained from the GEO database revealed a common dysregulated miRNA, miR-199b-5p.
evidence: This claim is supported by sequencing data from clinical samples and GEO database analysis as described in the manuscript.

claim: miR-199b-5p inhibits chondrocyte vitality in vitro.
source: In vitro cell experiments demonstrated that miR-199b-5p inhibits chondrocyte vitality and promotes extracellular matrix degradation.
evidence: This is supported by in vitro experimental data presented in the manuscript.

claim: miR-199b-5p promotes extracellular matrix degradation in vitro.
source: In vitro cell experiments demonstrated that miR-199b-5p inhibits chondrocyte vitality and promotes extracellular matrix degradation.
evidence: This is supported by in vitro experimental data presented in the manuscript.

claim: Inhibition of miR-199b-5p under inflammatory conditions exhibits protective effects against damage.
source: Conversely, inhibition of miR-199b-5p under inflammatory conditions exhibited protective effects against damage.
evidence: This is supported by experimental data from LPS-stimulated chondrocyte models.

claim: Local viral injection of miR-199b-5p into mice induces a decrease in pain threshold.
source: Local viral injection of miR-199b-5p into mice induced a decrease in pain threshold and OA-like changes.
evidence: This is supported by in vivo experimental data from mouse models.

claim: Local viral injection of miR-199b-5p into mice induces OA-like changes.
source: Local viral injection of miR-199b-5p into mice induced a decrease in pain threshold and OA-like changes.
evidence: This is supported by in vivo experimental data from mouse models.

claim: Inhibition of miR-199b-5p alleviated the pathological progression of OA in an OA model.
source: In an OA model, inhibition of miR-199b-5p alleviated the pathological progression of OA.
evidence: This is supported by experimental data from MIA-induced OA mouse models.

claim: Gcnt2 is a potential target gene of miR-199b-5p.
source: Furthermore, bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation identified Gcnt2 and Fzd6 as potential target genes of MiR-199b-5p.
evidence: This is supported by bioinformatics predictions and luciferase reporter assays.

claim: Fzd6 is a potential target gene of miR-199b-5p.
source: Furthermore, bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation identified Gcnt2 and Fzd6 as potential target genes of MiR-199b-5p.
evidence: This is supported by bioinformatics predictions and luciferase reporter assays.

claim: The miR-199b-5p/Gcnt2 and Fzd6 axis might be a novel therapeutic target for the treatment of OA.
source: Thus, these results indicated that MiR-199b-5p/Gcnt2 and Fzd6 axis might be a novel therapeutic target for the treatment of OA.
evidence: This is a speculative conclusion based on the experimental findings presented in the study.

claim: Osteoarthritis is characterized by the deterioration of articular cartilage.
source: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative disease characterized by the deterioration of articular cartilage and affecting all components of the joint, including the synovium, subchondral bone, and meniscus (Chen et al., 2017).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Chen et al., 2017.

claim: Osteoarthritis affects all components of the joint, including the synovium, subchondral bone, and meniscus.
source: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative disease characterized by the deterioration of articular cartilage and affecting all components of the joint, including the synovium, subchondral bone, and meniscus (Chen et al., 2017).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Chen et al., 2017.

claim: Knee OA (KOA) is the leading cause of disability among elderly patients.
source: Knee OA (KOA) is the leading cause of disability and increased living costs among elderly patients (Hunter and Osteoarthritis, 2019).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Hunter and Osteoarthritis, 2019.

claim: Knee OA (KOA) is associated with increased living costs among elderly patients.
source: Knee OA (KOA) is the leading cause of disability and increased living costs among elderly patients (Hunter and Osteoarthritis, 2019).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Hunter and Osteoarthritis, 2019.

claim: Current treatment options for osteoarthritis are limited to symptomatic relief and joint replacement.
source: Currently, the treatment options for osteoarthritis are limited to symptomatic relief and joint replacement.
evidence: This is a statement about current clinical practice that draws from established medical knowledge.

claim: Exosomes are extracellular vesicles that are distributed in body fluids such as serum.
source: Exosomes are extracellular vesicles that are distributed in body fluids such as serum and play a crucial biological role by delivering molecules such as microRNAs (miRNAs) (Xu et al., 2016).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Xu et al., 2016.

claim: Exosomes play a crucial biological role by delivering molecules such as microRNAs (miRNAs).
source: Exosomes are extracellular vesicles that are distributed in body fluids such as serum and play a crucial biological role by delivering molecules such as microRNAs (miRNAs) (Xu et al., 2016).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Xu et al., 2016.

claim: Exosomes serve as vital carriers for intercellular communication and transfer of genetic information.
source: They serve as vital carriers for intercellular communication and transfer of genetic information.
evidence: This is a general statement about exosome function that draws from established biological knowledge.

claim: miRNAs are a class of non-coding RNAs ranging from 18 to 24 nucleotides in length.
source: miRNAs are a class of non-coding RNAs ranging from 18 to 24 nucleotides in length, which exert inhibitory effects on the expression of target genes through interactions with mRNA.
evidence: This is a general statement about miRNA characteristics that draws from established molecular biology knowledge.

claim: miRNAs exert inhibitory effects on the expression of target genes through interactions with mRNA.
source: miRNAs are a class of non-coding RNAs ranging from 18 to 24 nucleotides in length, which exert inhibitory effects on the expression of target genes through interactions with mRNA.
evidence: This is a general statement about miRNA function that draws from established molecular biology knowledge.

claim: miRNAs play a crucial role as a pathogenic factor in OA.
source: Studies have demonstrated that miRNAs play a crucial role as a pathogenic factor in OA (Ali et al., 2021).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Ali et al., 2021.

claim: miR-199b-5p contributes to the osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow stromal cells.
source: For instance, miR-199b-5p was found to contribute to the osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow stromal cells (Zhao et al., 2016)
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Zhao et al., 2016.

claim: miR-140 shows cartilage-specific expression.
source: another miR-140 showed cartilage-specific expression, and its expression was significantly reduced in OA cartilage (Yamashita et al., 2012; Miyaki et al., 2009).
evidence: This is supported by citations to Yamashita et al., 2012 and Miyaki et al., 2009.

claim: miR-140 expression is significantly reduced in OA cartilage.
source: another miR-140 showed cartilage-specific expression, and its expression was significantly reduced in OA cartilage (Yamashita et al., 2012; Miyaki et al., 2009).
evidence: This is supported by citations to Yamashita et al., 2012 and Miyaki et al., 2009.

claim: Intra-articular injection of antisense oligonucleotides of miR-181a-5p produced chondroprotective effects in OA mice.
source: Recently, intra-articular injection of antisense oligonucleotides of miR-181a-5p produced chondroprotective effects in OA mice (Nakamura et al., 2019).
evidence: This is supported by a citation to Nakamura et al., 2019.

claim: 88 miRNAs were up-regulated in KOA patients compared with the control group based on fold change >1.5 and p<0.05.
source: The results showed that 88 miRNAs were up-regulated and 89 miRNAs were downregulated in KOA patients compared with the control group based on fold change >1.5 and p<0.05 (Figure 1A and B).
evidence: This is supported by sequencing data analysis shown in Figure 1A and B.

claim: 89 miRNAs were downregulated in KOA patients compared with the control group based on fold change >1.5 and p<0.05.

claim: Serum exosomes extracted from participants have a diameter ranging from approximately 70–150 nm.
source: After extraction, the serum exosomes were observed under transmission electron microscopy and nanoparticle tracking analysis, revealing a diameter ranging from approximately 70–150 nm (Figure 1—figure supplement 1A, B).
evidence: This is supported by transmission electron microscopy and nanoparticle tracking analysis data shown in Figure 1—figure supplement 1A, B.

claim: The surface marker proteins CD9, CD63, and CD81 are expressed on the exosomes.
source: Furthermore, the surface marker proteins CD9, CD63, and CD81 were found to be expressed on the exosomes (Figure 1—figure supplement 1C).
evidence: This is supported by western blot analysis shown in Figure 1—figure supplement 1C.

claim: Up-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in GO terms related to cell body, intracellular, and cytoplasm.

claim: Up-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in KEGG pathways including PI3K-AKT signaling, Ras signaling, apoptosis, and other types of O-glycan biosynthesis.

claim: Down-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in GO terms related to cell and intracellular.
source: The analysis of the top five down-regulated differential miRNAs reveals interesting findings. the CC (Cell GO:0005623, intracellular GO:0005622) GO terms were particularly noteworthy.

claim: Down-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in GO terms related to RNA polymerase II transcription factor activity and sequence-specific DNA binding.
source: The MF (RNA polymerase II transcription factor activity and sequence-specific DNA binding GO:0000981) GO terms, as well as the BP (collagen-activated signaling pathway GO:0038065) GO terms, were also deemed significant (Figure 1E).

claim: Down-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in GO terms related to collagen-activated signaling pathway.

claim: Down-regulated differentially expressed miRNAs are enriched in KEGG pathways including Hedgehog signaling pathway, pluripotency of stem cells, and glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis-keratan sulfate.

claim: Both up-regulated and down-regulated differential miRNA enrichment analyses are involved in processes related to cartilage synthesis, including O-glycan biosynthesis and glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis-keratan sulfate.

evidence: This is supported by CCK-8 assay data shown in Figure 2J (note: likely Figure 3J based on context).

claim: miR-199b-5p inhibitor reversed the decrease of cell viability caused by LPS (p<0.01).

claim: LPS elevated MMP3 expression (p<0.01).

claim: Intra-articular injection of miR-199b-5p mimic in normal mice resulted in a decrease in pain threshold (p<0.01).
source: In normal mice, miR-199b-5p mimic was injected into the joint of mice (Figure 4A) and a decrease in pain threshold was found (p<0.01) (Figure 4B).

claim: Serum IFN-γ was significantly increased four weeks after injection of miR-199b-5p mimic (p<0.01).
source: Four weeks later, serum IFN-γ (p<0.01) and TNF-α (p<0.01) were also significantly increased (Figure 4C and D).

claim: Serum TNF-α was significantly increased four weeks after injection of miR-199b-5p mimic (p<0.01).

claim: The injection of miR-199b-5p mimic in mouse joints resulted in a slight decrease in Safranine staining, although it did not reach statistical significance.

claim: The articular surface μCT image showed slight erosion after miR-199b-5p mimic injection.

claim: The level of serum IFN-γ in the miR-199b-5p inhibitor injection group was significantly decreased compared with the mimic group (p<0.01).

claim: The expression of IFN-γ decreased after inhibiting miRNA-199b-5p in the OA model (p<0.01).

claim: The expression of TNF-α decreased after inhibiting miRNA-199b-5p in the OA model (p<0.01).

claim: Six putative target genes of miRNA-199b-5p were identified using five miRNA target gene prediction tools.

evidence: This is supported by bioinformatics analysis using multiple prediction tools shown in Figure 6A.

claim: Luciferase reporter assays confirmed that miR-199b-5p can potentially bind to and suppress the expression of Gcnt2 (p<0.01).
